- paragraph: Not all the data are public. The Regulation defines who sees what. The general public, the repairers and recyclers who justify a legitimate interest, and the authorities. Here is what each sees on a stationary storage battery.
- paragraph: Product and manufacturer identity, characteristics, carbon footprint, recycled content, end-of-life instructions. What a buyer, an insurer or an end customer sees. A competitor too.
- paragraph: Detailed cathode and anode chemistry, dismantling manual, part references, safety measures, degradation model. Available on justification, not in the open.
- paragraph: Test reports and conformity documents, reserved for inspection.
- paragraph: You give us what you have, the platform produces the rest. Unique identifier, QR code ready to print, page published and kept up to date.

- paragraph: Illustrative example built on a real data structure. GreenGrid Energy SAS is a fictional company. Seqo publishes no customer data. This document is not a passport within the meaning of the Regulation.
